dataset_name: Papusoy Farm Historical Monthly Disease Dataset
description: Climate-free monthly historical disease dataset for offline monthly analytics.
month_source: The application reads the current month from the device date.

percentage_definition.historical_mean_incidence_pct: Historical mean incidence percentage supplied by the source dataset. Display as historical average incidence, not as the probability that a disease will occur next month.
percentage_definition.historical_index_0_100: A normalized historical index from the source dataset. Display as a historical risk index, not a calibrated probability.
percentage_definition.historical_frequency_share_pct: Omitted because the source values are uniform across disease classes and do not distinguish disease likelihood.

limitations: The source contains monthly aggregated indicators, not individual year-by-year disease outcome records.
The dataset does not provide a calibrated probability of future disease occurrence.
Climate fields have been removed from this application dataset.
Local farm records can be analyzed separately after confirmed observations are collected.
